why: reviewer (error): obhe is not a typo: it is the Vedic sandhi ā + ubhe (ā belongs to paprāḥ: 'ā prāḥ' = filled up). The Ṛgvedic parallel RV 6.19.6 itself reads 'ródasī obhé suśipra prāḥ', so the flag invents a variant and the claim 'the RV parallel reads ubhe' is false.
reviewer (error): token obhe must be split as ā + ubhe (ā + u > o); the preverb ā goes with paprāḥ.

old: Ṛgvedic mantra (RV 6.19.6). didhṛkṣema taken as desiderative optative of √dhṛ; yat as the relative pronoun referring to śravaḥ.
new: Ṛgvedic mantra (RV 6.19.6, which reads papuri and, in its second half, yeneme citra vajrahasta rodasī obhe suśipra prāḥ). obhe = ā + ubhe (Vedic sandhi), the ā belonging to paprāḥ ('filled up'). didhṛkṣema taken as desiderative optative of √dhṛ; yat as the relative pronoun referring to śravaḥ.
why: reviewer (minor): note should record the obhe = ā ubhe analysis instead of the false claim about the RV reading.
